title: The theme catalog and picker are built from the manifests, with filters and your site on this theme

source.ref: Theme cohesion sweep (docs/THEME-COHESION.md, ADR-1923). Owner picks 2026-10-29: role blocks and manifest, phased; no live site changes on its own.

detail: Coordinate with the thread that owns the /themes pages before touching them (done: it confirmed read-only and named the six files that import lib/themes/library, whose exports stay unchanged). Shipped: the catalog words (tagline, made for, signature, four surface lines) are now the `library` section of each lib/themes/manifests/<id>.manifest.json, hand-edited there; lib/themes/library.ts reads them in a fixed offer order, so the picker, the /themes pages and Try it on read one record. The manifest generator keeps those words and no longer rewrites them. NOT in this row: the catalog filters and the 'your site on this theme' control on the /themes pages, which belong to the theme pages thread.

verify.note: Reads the wiring this row ships; fails on main. The behaviour is pinned by the row's own tests.
